Overview.Name: Anitha
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues

Meal_1: Option 1: Vegetable dosa (1) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (small portion) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer stir fry (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since anxiety and stress can increase fried cravings, choose pan cooked foods instead of deep fried snacks.
Keep lunch slightly stronger with protein and vegetables to maintain steady energy through the day.
Because appearance and health are goals, keep rice moderate and make paneer, dal or eggs the main portion.
During social gatherings eat protein first so you naturally reduce overeating.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent without stress.
